message:
My complainent with T-Netix (EVercom Systems Inc.) is there billing practices. I began receiving calls in Oct 2007 (approx 4 a day) from the Fresno County Jail of which I immediately hung up because I knew no one in jail. This went on for 10-days till I called the Sheriffs Dept and had a block put on my phone. November bill from my phone company comes and what do you know  billing from T- Netix! So  I called their 800 number to demand a credit to my bill. First it won't get me to a person to discuss this mistake with because you have to have a 4-digit personal "code". Of which I didn't have ----and was not about to set up since this was there mistake! After continued research i got a number of an actual person a T-Netix to call. I  finally was connected to  that  person who proceded to be very rude to me when I denied ever accepting any calls. Finally after  much complaining  and insisting they said I would be issued the credit to my phone bill.    BUT ----Here is the clincher------ It will be 2-3 months (billing cycles) before it would credit to my account. Well it didn't take them 2-3 months to bill me so why the delay on a credit? I said that was not acceptable and asked first for a supervisor (to no avail) and then I asked for an address to send a complaint.   I was told there was no corporate address and I would have to email or call them again.  What do they mean no corporate office?
What a substandard  shady business the states and corrections dept have gotten involved with!!!!
